comment: Metro - test tool, not part of the pack: a metronome click on Segue's beat grid, to hear whether Segue's kick tracker locks to the sequencer. The tracker is copied unchanged from Segue (first kick after loading is bar 1; LoBPM, HiBPM, Thrsh, Listn as there). The input passes through; once the tempo is locked a click is mixed in on every beat: 800 Hz beats, 1.6 kHz bar starts, 2.4 kHz phrase starts (every Bars bars, where Segue would start recording). Click KICK instead clicks on every onset the detector takes for a kick (about 20 ms late, locked or not). Any footswitch press (on or off) resets bar 1 to the next kick. Page 1: Mix (DJ-style: 50 = both full, 100 = clicks only), Click (BEAT / BAR / KICK), Bars. Page 2: LoBPM, HiBPM, Thrsh. Page 3: Listn.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 Segue, 492 Metro (this repo). Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: DJ-style crossfade between the input and the clicks: input full from 0 to 50, clicks full from 50 to 100, both full at 50. 100 = clicks only. Default 50.

params.name: Click
params.comment: BEAT = a click on every beat (800 Hz), higher on bar starts (1.6 kHz) and phrase starts (2.4 kHz). BAR = only the bar and phrase clicks. KICK = no grid: a 1 kHz click on every onset the detector accepts as a kick, about 20 ms after it starts, locked or not. BEAT and BAR click only once the tempo is locked. Default BEAT.

params.name: Bars
params.comment: Phrase length for the phrase click, shown as 1 to 8 bars (screen value + 1), counted from bar 1 as Segue counts them. Default 8.

params.name: LoBPM
params.comment: As Segue: slowest tempo the tracker may lock to, 40 to 240 BPM (below 40 reads as 40). Default 140.

params.name: HiBPM
params.comment: As Segue: fastest tempo the tracker may lock to, 40 to 240 BPM. LoBPM = HiBPM fixes the tempo. Default 170.

params.name: Thrsh
params.comment: As Segue: how sudden a jump in the kick band must be to count as a kick: AUTO (2 x), or 1 (1.3 x) to 100 (20 x). Default AUTO.

params.name: Listn
params.comment: As Segue: the kick detector's low-pass, AUTO (100 Hz) or 50 to 150 Hz. Default AUTO.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
